mechanism_fingerprint.primary_cognitive_job: Compress a broad landscape of people, companies, tools or signals into a navigable overview.
use_when: The collection has a defensible scope and grouping logic.
The reader gains orientation from seeing the landscape together.
Sources, dates and exclusions can be named.
do_not_use_when: The map creates an implied ranking without evidence.
Entries are incomplete but presented as exhaustive.
The reader needs a focused decision rather than an overview.

Correct logic, process or sourced evidence proportionate to the selected claim.
An original visual object/scene/interface that proves the chosen promise.
A caption that adds a different layer of value from the visual.

any source claim not independently supportable
